We estimate the noise floor from 250 segments of data.
The bias of the estimator vanishes for long segments~\cite{smith2020}.
\begin{equation}
  b = \frac{c}{N} \label{eq:bias}
\end{equation}
The estimator is therefore consistent.
\begin{thebibliography}{1}
\bibitem{smith2020} A. Smith, Estimators of noise, J. Stat. 12 (2020) 1.
\end{thebibliography}
